name: Make Influence for WooCommerce
author: Patrick Thagaard

sections.description: Install this plugin and connect your WooCommerce store with the Make Influence platform. This plugin is compatible with WooCommerce 3.1+ and works with all major payment providers.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin’s folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install it through the plugin installer

  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress

  3. Navigate to Make Influence

  4. Insert your Business ID
